description: Activate when: user says 'will AI disrupt us?', 'which parts of our business will AI replace?', 'is our moat still there in the AI era?', 'run an AI impact assessment', or customers have started using AI tools to do work they used to pay us for, or an AI-native competitor has entered at a much lower price. Do NOT activate when: the question is only which AI tool to adopt for internal efficiency (no business-model question); the business has no formed value chain to break down; a transformation plan already exists and needs stress-testing (use premortem); the question is general disruption theory with no AI angle (use disruptive-innovation). More: deciqai.com/c/ai-disruption-risk-audit
